text.offer: My court mages feel a dark magic gathering beneath the Twisted Woods. They trace it to the orc caves, and to the wizards who lead the orcs there. I would have thee go down and break their strength: begin with fifteen of their warriors, so that the wizards have no shield.
text.progress: The orc caves lie behind an illusionary wall in a cave west of Tos. Thou must dispel the illusion to pass.
text.complete: My mages say the gathering magic falters. Thou hast done the crown a great service.

steps.brief: Now the wizards themselves. Ten of them, and their magic will scatter.
